result.notes: Official OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec exists at api.pitchbook.com/api-docs showing a broad REST surface (companies, deals, patents, investors, funds, financials, social analytics) authenticated via a custom pbToken/PB-Token header. However, the API is sold as a separate enterprise add-on to the PitchBook Platform subscription, requires a standalone contract negotiated with PitchBook's Direct Data team, and has no self-serve signup or free trial. Sandbox keys are provisioned manually by the account team on request, not generated by developers themselves. Public developer docs (Postman collection, endpoint guide) are gated behind being a contracted client, so capability/schema details cannot be verified pre-contract.
result.one_liner: PitchBook is a private-market financial data platform (companies, deals, funds, investors, valuations) offering a REST API as a paid, contract-gated add-on to its subscription platform.
